tracker.$comment: under `then`, not `properties`: a typed optional key beside a string index does not compile in TypeScript

connectors.description: kind → expected type, e.g. tracker: github-issues; the tracker may be `plugin:<plugin>/<server>`, the server of a plugin that declares `implements: [tracker]` (ADR 0093, S43-05b; checked when the plugin is validated, run by S43-07)

azure_capabilities.description: Azure resource providers to register, e.g. Microsoft.App/managedEnvironments

org_connectors.description: the ORGANISATION's connectors that the workflows call, by name → capability (S20-07), e.g. annuaire: identity

workflow.description: a single workflow: the form used before `workflows`

workflows.description: the workflows shipped (ADR 0031): `template:<name>@<v>`, a core template, or a path relative to the template's folder (`workflows/arrivee.yaml`)

default_workflow.description: the default workflow's name; otherwise the first one shipped

routing.description: the project's routing rules, as PUT /projects/{id}/workflow-routing

agents.description: the agents installed in the organisation when a project is born, if they are not there: files of the template in the `POST /orgs/{org}/agents` format, or `catalogue:<slug>` (S20-07, ADR 0040)

skills.description: the skills installed the same way: folders of the template, each with its SKILL.md, or `catalogue:<slug>` (S20-07)

knowledge.description: the knowledge bases the template's agents read (S51-06, ADR 0117), in the shape of the CLI's `kind: KnowledgeBase` manifest less what the project decides (scope, uploads, eval set): each is created for a project born of the template, served to it and owned by it, its sources attached and synced at once; a base of that slug already served to the project is reused, never rewritten

slug.description: the slug the agents name in `spec.knowledge`

kind.description: a git repository; other kinds need an organisation connector a template cannot know

connector.description: an organisation `documents/git` connector for a private repository; without it the project's own repository is read through the deployment's GitHub App, any other anonymously

url_from_input.description: the template input that holds the repository: `owner/name` (a `github-repo` input) or an https URL; a `github-repo` input left empty is the project's repository

paths.description: glob patterns; markdown anywhere by default

config.$comment: exactly one of `url` and `url_from_input`, said with if/then/else: a oneOf beside `properties` does not compile in TypeScript

extensions.description: what a PLUGIN installs in the project when it is born: an installer name → a folder of the template (`ontology: ./ontology`). Without a plugin to install it, the project is born without it, and the audit log says so (S20-09)

steps.description: the provisioning steps; none for a project without a repository (S20-07)
